findings.fix: Move the broadly useful `CodimensionOnePoint` definition to an earlier scheme-dimension module (such as `Scheme/KrullDimension.lean`), update repository imports, and have this module import that lower-level home instead.

summary: The point/place correspondence is placed in the generic Scheme.Place hierarchy while depending on the Weil-divisor layer solely for the codimension-one-point type, reversing the natural dependency direction.
